info.title: LLMKit - Token Counter, RAG Chunker, HTML to Markdown & JSON Repair
info.description:
# LLMKit: Token Counter, RAG Chunker, HTML to Markdown and JSON Repair

The plumbing every LLM app needs, as a fast API: exact token counts, token-aware chunking for RAG, token-budget truncation, text cleaning, web page or HTML to Markdown, and robust JSON extraction and repair from model output. No model calls, so it is cheap and deterministic.

**Who it's for:** developers building chatbots, agents, RAG pipelines and AI features in any language, especially where tiktoken is not available (no-code tools, edge runtimes, mobile).

## Use cases
- Estimate prompt cost and check context-window fit before every call.
- Chunk documents with overlap before embedding them into a vector database.
- Trim chat history to a token budget, keeping the most recent turns.
- Turn web pages into compact Markdown for grounding prompts.
- Reliably parse JSON from models that wrap it in prose or produce trailing commas.

## Quickstart
Subscribe on RapidAPI (a free plan is available), copy your key, then:

```bash
curl --request GET \
  --url 'https://llmkit-token-counter-rag-chunker-json-repair.p.rapidapi.com/tokens?text=Hello%20world&encoding=o200k_base' \
  --header 'X-RapidAPI-Key: YOUR_RAPIDAPI_KEY' \
  --header 'X-RapidAPI-Host: llmkit-token-counter-rag-chunker-json-repair.p.rapidapi.com'
```

## Authentication
Every request goes through RapidAPI. Send `X-RapidAPI-Key` (your key) and `X-RapidAPI-Host` (`llmkit-token-counter-rag-chunker-json-repair.p.rapidapi.com`) on every call. Requests that bypass the gateway are rejected with `403`.

## Good to know
- Text inputs accept up to 2,000,000 characters. POST endpoints take JSON `{"text": ...}`; GET endpoints take `text` in the query string.
- Token counts use OpenAI's tiktoken encodings; for non-OpenAI models treat them as close estimates.
- Web fetching (to-markdown) has a 10 second timeout and does not run JavaScript.

## Rate limits and plans
Request quotas and per-second limits depend on the RapidAPI plan you subscribe to; see the Pricing tab. When a limit is reached the gateway returns `429 Too Many Requests`; retry with exponential backoff or move to a higher plan.

## Errors
All errors are JSON. The API returns `{"error": "<reason>"}` with a meaningful HTTP status: `400` disallowed URL (not http/https, or a private address), `413` input too large, `415` fetched URL is not HTML, `422` missing or invalid parameter, `502` upstream site or service failed, `503` temporarily unavailable, retry shortly. Gateway errors (`401`/`403`/`429`) come from RapidAPI as `{"message": "<reason>"}`.

## Data sources and licences
- Tokenization: OpenAI tiktoken encodings (MIT licence).
- Web pages are fetched from the URL you provide; respect the target site's terms.

## MCP (AI agents)
This API is also available as a Model Context Protocol server at `POST /mcp` on the same RapidAPI host; see the MCP endpoint for setup.

get.description: Returns the exact token count for the chosen tiktoken encoding, plus characters, words, characters per token and the models that use the encoding. Use it to estimate cost and check context-window fit before calling a model. Counts are exact for OpenAI models and a good approximation for others.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Input text (max 2,000,000 characters; 413 above that). In a GET query string, keep text within your HTTP client's URL length limit.
parameters.example: Hello world, this is a token counter.

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.description: Tokenizer: `o200k_base` (GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, o-series), `cl100k_base` (GPT-4, GPT-3.5, text-embedding-3), `p50k_base` (Codex, text-davinci), `r50k_base` (GPT-3).

post.summary: Split text into token-sized chunks for RAG
post.description: Splits long text into chunks of at most `chunk_size` tokens with `overlap` tokens of context carried between neighbours, ready for embedding and vector search. `tokens` mode cuts exactly on token boundaries; `sentences` and `paragraphs` modes keep whole sentences or paragraphs together (a single unit longer than `chunk_size` becomes its own chunk). Settings can be given as query parameters or as fields in the JSON body.

parameters.name: overlap
parameters.description: Tokens of overlap between consecutive chunks (clamped to 0-2000; must be smaller than chunk_size).

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: How to split: exact `tokens`, whole `sentences`, or whole `paragraphs` (blank-line separated).

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.description: Tokenizer: `o200k_base` (GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, o-series), `cl100k_base` (GPT-4, GPT-3.5, text-embedding-3), `p50k_base` (Codex, text-davinci), `r50k_base` (GPT-3).

example.text:
First sentence here. Second sentence follows. A third one ends the paragraph.

New paragraph starts.

chunks.text: First sentence here. Second sentence follows.
Second sentence follows. A third one ends the paragraph.

422.description: Missing text, overlap >= chunk_size, or invalid mode/encoding.

example.error: overlap must be smaller than chunk_size

get.summary: Truncate text to a token budget
get.description: Cuts text to at most `max_tokens` tokens, keeping the start or the end, and reports the original and final token counts. Cuts on token boundaries, so the result always fits.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Input text (max 2,000,000 characters; 413 above that). In a GET query string, keep text within your HTTP client's URL length limit.
parameters.example: A long prompt that needs to fit in a context window.

parameters.name: keep
parameters.description: Keep the `start` (drop the tail) or the `end` (drop the head, useful for chat history).

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.description: Tokenizer: `o200k_base` (GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, o-series), `cl100k_base` (GPT-4, GPT-3.5, text-embedding-3), `p50k_base` (Codex, text-davinci), `r50k_base` (GPT-3).

example.text: A long prompt that needs to fit in

get.summary: Normalise and clean text for LLMs
get.description: Applies Unicode NFKC normalisation, removes zero-width and bidirectional control characters, collapses runs of spaces and tabs, trims spaces around newlines and limits blank lines to one. Reduces wasted tokens and prompt-injection tricks hidden in invisible characters.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Input text (max 2,000,000 characters; 413 above that). In a GET query string, keep text within your HTTP client's URL length limit.

post.summary: Extract and repair JSON from LLM output
post.description: Finds the first JSON object or array in chatty model output (including inside ```json fences) and parses it. If it is malformed, it repairs common LLM mistakes: trailing commas, single quotes, unquoted keys, // comments, Python True/False/None, and missing closing brackets or quotes. `repaired` tells you whether fixes were needed.

422.description: No JSON found, or it could not be repaired.

example.error: Found JSON-like text but could not repair it

get.summary: Convert a URL or HTML to Markdown
get.description: Fetches a web page (or takes raw HTML) and returns clean Markdown of its main content with the title and its o200k_base token count, ready to drop into a prompt. Scripts, styles, navigation, footers and forms are removed. Give `url` or `html`; `url` wins if both are sent.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Public http(s) page URL (max 2048 characters). Up to 5 redirects are followed; private addresses are refused.

parameters.name: html
parameters.description: Raw HTML to convert instead of fetching a URL. Must be URL-encoded; best for small snippets.

parameters.name: max_chars
parameters.description: Maximum characters of Markdown returned (clamped to 500-200000).

value.markdown: This domain is for use in documentation examples without needing permission. This is not a service; avoid relying on it for testing and monitoring purposes.
value.title: Example Domain

422.description: Neither url nor html supplied, or the host does not resolve.

url.description: Final URL after redirects (URL input only).

markdown.description: Markdown of the main content, cut to max_chars.
